[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | commonsalvage = 1 [[Bone]] | raresalvage = 1 [[Monstrous Claw]] | render = [[File:Large Claw.jpg|150px]] }} [[Roaring Ether Claw]]s are items [[drop]]ped by [[Roaring Ether (Vabbi)|Roaring Ether]]s in parts of [[Vabbi]]. They are used to make charm bracelets. == Acquisition == * [[Vabbi]] ** [[Roaring Ether (Vabbi)|Roaring Ether]] {{ongoing item research}} ===Farming=== ;[[The Mirror of Lyss]] [[File:Mirror of Lyss Roaring Ether Claw farm.jpg|thumb|[[Farming]] route in The Mirror of Lyss]] Enter from [[Dzagonur Bastion (outpost)|Dzagonur Bastion]] or [[Honur Hill]]. There is an [[Elemental Hunt]] [[bounty]] available outside Dzagonur Bastion. If your [[character]] does not need [[Lightbringer rank|Lightbringer points]] but you want [[blessing]]s, you can determine which outpost you enter from based on the blessings offered by the [[avatar]] outside of the outpost (i.e. [[Champion of Balthazar]] and [[Lyssa's Muse]] outside Dzagonur Bastion and Honur Hill, respectively). There are nine groups of four [[elemental]]s each in the eastern part of the zone. Most of these groups contain three Roaring Ethers, but some contain only two. Only the level 24 Roaring Ethers have [[Resurrection Signet]] and there are usually one or two of these to a group. They will not use Resurrection Signet on the [[Ruby Djinn]] or [[Sapphire Djinn]] in their group. Prioritizing Ruby or Sapphire Djinn, and then Roaring Ethers with unspent Resurrection Signets will make the fights easier. If farming for Nicholas the Traveler, he collects [[Sapphire Djinn Essence]]s in [[Nicholas the Traveler/Cycle|the tenth week]] after collecting Roaring Ether Claws, so consider keeping any Sapphire Djinn Essences that drop. == Collectors == {{:Dahwan/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|24th May 2010 and 30th April 2012|Garden of Seborhin|2 [[Roaring Ether Claw]]s}}
